title: Korea / DPRK / Yellow Sea
subtitle: DPRK provocations, Korean memory knock-ons, Pacific defense pull
query: North Korea DPRK Kim Jong Un ICBM missile test Yellow Sea provocation South Korea US defense alliance
newsFallbackQueries: North Korea missile launch ICBM Pyongyang
South Korea defense THAAD Patriot procurement
Samsung SK Hynix Korea semiconductor risk
summary: DPRK launch cadence and Yellow Sea provocations drive Pacific defense pulls (THAAD, Patriot, Aegis BMD), Korean memory/foundry knock-ons via Samsung and SK Hynix ADR proxies, and risk-off USD bid against KRW.
secondOrderEffects: DPRK launches usually tighten Korean defense procurement and US Pacific posture rather than triggering kinetic action, so defense beats consumer-tech beta.
Memory and foundry concentration in Korea makes Samsung and SK Hynix the cleanest single-name Korea-binary expressions; the EWY country ETF is a faster proxy than ADRs.
Risk-off flows into USD and away from KRW often outlast the immediate headline cycle, lifting dollar-strength expressions even after launch news fades.
